info.title: IntentControlPlaneService
info.description: Administrative API for Intent Router provisioning and lifecycle.

get.description: Lists the models a Router can be configured with, from deployment configuration. The embedding items are the only valid values of vectorSpace: creating a Router with any other is refused with 400. Empty when none are configured, which offers every vector space (development only).

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: What a model is used for. A product serves only the purposes it supports.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Page size of a list. Defaults to 50 where a service does not say otherwise. A list may
document a smaller maximum, never a larger one.

post.description: Creates and provisions one Router and returns it with 201, a Location header and, while it is PROVISIONING, Retry-After. A deployment-configured per-tenant limit applies; the default is 128. An optional Idempotency-Key (<client-id>:<sha256 of the canonical body>) makes a retry return the first response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; keys are kept for 24 hours.

minScore.description: Minimum score for a match; higher is stricter. Defaults to 0.7. Zero is the same as omitting it: a Router has no zero threshold.

databaseId.description: The customer database to keep this Router's intents, examples and search index in. Create-only. On-prem, omit it to use the deployment's default database, or name one of the databases the deployment offers; some deployments require it. In the cloud it is required and must be a Redis Cloud database in the caller's account that is active, has a default user and a public endpoint, and runs the Search and Query engine.
